title: 10，如果这世界上真的有地狱，也不过如此了吧！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“怎么回事....怎么回事.....”

穆萨猛地抬起头，嘴巴张得很大，像是在吼什么。

沈飞听不见。

他只能看见穆萨那口白得刺眼的牙，在黑暗和火光之间一开一合。

周围所有声音都像是被人一把按进了水里。

只剩下耳朵里尖锐的嗡鸣声。

穆萨还在喊：“他们打我们？！”

“沈！他们打我们？！”

“妈的！我看不到！我听不到！”

“我们要死了.....上帝...我们要被炸死了...”

他慌了，

沈飞他妈的也慌了。

脑子里嗡嗡作响，嘴里甚至有一股淡淡的铁锈味。

他比穆萨多

第一发炮弹如果没打中，不代表结束，而很有可能是校射，也就是试探落点。

如果天上有无人机在看，如果炮手正在修正坐标，那么下一发就不会再落在林带边缘。

它会更近。

甚至直接砸到他们面前。

虽然不知道炮弹落下的时候，射击坑里负责警戒的人该不该跑，但那都不重要。

先跑再说！

沈飞猛地伸手，一把抓住穆萨的肩膀，几乎是贴着他的脸大吼：“校射，这是他妈的校射！”

“快躲进防空洞！”

穆萨愣了一下。

啥是校射？

沈飞继续大吼道，“他妈的，下一发很有可能打到我们的裤裆里！”

“进洞！”

“快！”

他说完，也不管穆萨有没有反应过来，直接拽着他的背带往后拖。

穆萨体格很大，重得像一头黑熊。

可人在极度恐惧和求生欲面前，总能爆发出一点平时没有的力气。

沈飞半拖半拽，把穆萨从射击坑里拽出来，弯着腰往主壕沟方向冲。

两人几乎是滚进泥里的。

壕沟里也终于传来维克多模糊变形的吼声。

“进洞！”

“离射击口远点！”

"What's going on...what's going on..."

Musa raised his head suddenly and opened his mouth wide, as if he was shouting something.

Shen Fei couldn't hear it.

He could only see Moussa's dazzling white teeth, opening and closing between the darkness and the firelight.

All the sounds around him sounded like they were being pushed into the water.

All that was left was a sharp ringing in his ears.

Moussa was still shouting: "They beat us?!"

"Shen! Are they beating us?!"

"Damn! I can't see! I can't hear!"

"We're going to die... God... we're going to be blown up..."

He panicked,

Shen Fei was also fucking panicked.

My mind was buzzing, and there was even a faint taste of rust in my mouth.

He is more than Musa

If the first shell misses, it does not mean it is over, but it is most likely a calibration shot, which is a test of the landing point.

If there is a drone watching from the sky, if the gunner is correcting the coordinates, then the next shot will no longer land on the edge of the forest belt.

It will be closer.

Even hit them directly.

Although I don't know if the person in charge of the security in the shooting pit should run when the shells fall, but that doesn't matter.

Run first and then talk!

Shen Fei suddenly stretched out his hand, grabbed Musa's shoulders, and almost shouted in his face: "School shooting, this is a fucking school shooting!"

"Hide in the air-raid shelter!"

Musa was stunned for a moment.

What is a school shooting?

Shen Fei continued to yell, "Damn it, the next shot will probably hit our crotches!"

"Enter the hole!"

"Quick!"

After he finished speaking, regardless of whether Musa reacted or not, he directly grabbed his strap and dragged him back.

Musa was huge and as heavy as a black bear.

But in the face of extreme fear and desire to survive, people can always burst out with a little bit of strength that they don't usually have.

Shen Fei half dragged and half dragged Musa out of the shooting pit, bent over and rushed towards the main trench.

The two of them almost rolled into the mud.

Victor's vague and deformed roar finally came from the trench.

"Enter the hole!"

"Stay away from the shooting port!"
